Results.ReviewText: J'ai acheté ce barbecue le mois dernier et je m'en suis servi à plusieurs reprises depuis. C'est de loin le barbecue au charbon le mieux pensé et offrant de multiples possibilités avec ses accessoires de base et ses extensions achetables. Très bon maintien de la chaleur et goût incomparable de charbon au menu. Le seul point à améliorer est l'assemblage du produit: les pattes ont été difficiles à insérer, du lubrifiant et plusieurs dizaines de minutes ont été nécessaires. Results.ReviewText: What can’t this grill do? With the included charcoal baskets and Gourmet BBQ System grate, I’ve been able so far to high temp indirect cook chicken, low and slow indirect smoke beef ribs, pork ribs, and a pulled-beef chuck roast, two-zone grill steaks to perfection, and I’ve only had it a month! There’s so much more to try. I can hardly wait to push the charcoal baskets together in the center and use it as a high-heat source for my wok! Should work great! I’m never looking back!
Results.Title: Master-Touch: So Versatile!

ClientResponses.Response:
Thank you for your feedback! We are happy to hear you are loving your new Master-Touch grill but yet we also understand your concerns about potential rust on the grill. No worries, we are here to help!

The lids and bowls of our charcoal kettles are coated in porcelain enamel. Porcelain enamel is essentially baked on glass, which is very different than paint. If the porcelain enamel has become damaged, replacing the affected part is the only solution. Touch-up paint should NOT be used on damaged or chipped porcelain enamel.

We would like to review the coating on the lid. Here at Weber, we stand by the quality of our products and cover them under great warranties. Our goal is to have you love our products just as much as we do. 

Our kind Support team would like to follow up with you. Please be on the lookout for an email, thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

14511601.Name: 22” Master-Touch™ Charcoal Grill
14511601.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Master-Touch™ Charcoal Grill. This grill features a handy Tuck-Away Lid Holder that gives you a convenient place to nest the lid against the side of the bowl, a hinged cooking grate that fits circular GBS accessories so you can explore more ways to cook, a built-in lid thermometer, and legs that are 2” taller than standard kettles. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retain heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate fits circular GBS grillware· Included Char-Rails make it easy to arrange charcoal· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Tuck-Away Lid Holder provides handy space to hang lid· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels.· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant and 2” taller· 10-year limited warranty
